principles: Four skills plus interaction, pronunciation and mediation where age and level appropriate
Observable evidence and rubric for each lesson
No formal CEFR claim for the preschool PRE pathway

PRE.preschool: Attend, point, move, choose and voluntarily imitate in 5–8 minute parent-guided encounters.

A0.adult: Literacy and orientation bridge before A1.
A0.school: Alphabet, sound-symbol mapping, classroom routines and very familiar words.

A1.adult: Meet concrete needs, introduce self and interact simply with slow clear support.
A1.school: Answer basic personal and everyday questions and understand short familiar instructions.

A2.adult: Handle routine exchanges, immediate needs and simple descriptions.
A2.school: Link short sentences about familiar people, school, hobbies and events.

B1.adult: Deal with common work and travel situations, describe experiences and give simple reasons.
B1.school: Understand main points on familiar school topics and create connected short texts.

B2.adult: Interact with fluency, explain viewpoints and understand extended texts.
B2.school: Discuss familiar and some abstract topics with supporting detail.

C1.adult: Use language flexibly for academic and professional purposes and present complex subjects clearly.
C1.school: Advanced optional pathway with age-appropriate academic projects and safeguarding.

C2.adult: Understand virtually everything, synthesise sources and express precise nuanced meaning.
C2.school: Not a default target for the current 11-year-old pathway.
